title: Task
description: Represents the full state of a task, as returned by GET /tasks/{id}.

task_id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for this task.

capability_id.description: The capability this task was submitted to.

input.description: Echo of the original task input.

result.description: Present when status is completed. Conforms to the capability's output_schema.

error.description: Present when status is failed. See error.schema.json.
